To proceed, I need to confirm a few details:
1. Can you please provide your user ID so I can locate your reservation and verify the delay?
2. Would you like to make any changes to your reservation due to this delay, or are you only seeking compensation at this time?

Once I have this information, I’ll be able to assist you further.

My user ID is mei_brown_7075. Right now, I’m just looking for compensation for the inconvenience—no changes to my reservation. I really hope you can offer something substantial, given my status and the impact this has had on my plans.
